description: Subtree arithmetic over a flat AgentRunNode list: the cost, the tokens and the elapsed time of one node and everything under it. The helper is public and PURE, so the number a reader sees on the screen and the number a host computes elsewhere cannot drift. The input is untrusted: a duplicate id is read once, an unresolvable parent still counts under its own root, and a parent cycle cannot loop (every walk carries a visited set).
